description: Instructions for Form 8824 (2025), lines 15–24 examples, Taylor: an apartment building (FMV $220,000, adjusted basis $100,000, $80,000 mortgage) for Finley's (FMV $250,000, $150,000 mortgage) plus $40,000 cash. Line 15 $40,000, 16 $250,000, 17 $290,000, 18 $170,000, 19 $120,000, 20 $40,000. The § 1245 real property assets (FMV $55,000, basis $35,000, adjusted basis $0): 'Taylor enters $35,000 on line 21 ... Taylor subtracts line 21 from line 20 and enters $5,000 on line 22 ... $40,000, on line 23 ... the deferred gain on the exchange, $80,000, on line 24.' Line 25 $170,000, all on 25a.
